memories.retry_policy: Wrap outbound HTTP calls in withRetry from lib/net; never hand-roll exponential backoff.
memories.db_access: Analytics reports must read from the replica database, never the primary.
memories.pr_size: Keep pull requests under 400 changed lines; split migrations into their own PR.
memories.money_units: Store money as integer cents; never use floating point for amounts.
memories.auth_tokens: Read API tokens from the secrets manager at startup; never log or hard-code them.
memories.date_handling: Store timestamps in UTC and convert to the user's timezone only in the UI.
memories.error_reporting: Report unexpected errors through captureError so they reach the error tracker with context.
memories.feature_flags: Gate unfinished features behind a flag in flags/registry.ts; remove the flag once fully rolled out.
memories.test_style: Tests sit next to the code as *.test.ts and use real temp directories, not mocked file systems.
memories.pagination: Page large reads with keyset pagination on (created_at, id), never OFFSET.
memories.logging: Use the structured logger with a request id; no console.log in production code.
memories.migrations: Database migrations are append-only; never edit a migration that has been applied.
